label: preparing
what: A surprise tribute for my forty years of mayoral service, in the great hall on day 1 at precisely 18:00, disguised as a lighting inspection. Innkeeper arranges catering, Freight delivers bread, and Builder handles lighting. Secretary knowingly helps preserve the appointment and my attendance, although has now disclosed the surprise to me. Reportedly 128 fresh loaves and eight lanterns are ready, with 72 more loaves planned.
